title: Adaptive Financial Recommendation Systems Using Generative AI and Multimodal Data
tldr: GenAI-powered framework achieves up to 30% improvement in recommendation relevance and 25% increase in user engagement for personalized financial product recommendations.
problem_and_motivation: Traditional financial recommendation systems built on static rules or pre-trained models struggle to adapt to fast-paced changes in consumer behavior, macroeconomic conditions, and financial product offerings. These systems lack responsiveness to behavioral drift and user sentiment, cannot adapt to real-time changes, and fail to capture non-numeric signals like emotion or intention. There is a need for hyper-personalization in financial services.
approach: Novel framework combining LLMs, GANs, and RLHF for personalized recommendations.
Multi-modal data integration: structured (transaction logs, credit history) and unstructured (conversations, feedback).
User profiling engine using neural embeddings and unsupervised learning (K-means++, UMAP).
Generative model layer with fine-tuned LLMs (GPT-4, FinGPT, Claude) for scenario-specific narratives.
Reinforcement learning loop with human feedback (RLHF) for continuous personalization.
Ethical and XAI layer applying SHAP, LIME, and counterfactual testing.
Evaluation using synthetic financial datasets with Monte Carlo simulations.
findings: num: 28-35% improvement in Top-N precision and recall over traditional models.
num: 22% increase in engagement duration with feedback loops.
num: 18% higher acceptance of recommended financial products.
num: 36% reduction in product rejection rate.
num: 23% reduction in disparate impact scores with fairness constraints.
num: 18% increase in equal opportunity scores.
num: 40% higher engagement rate with transparent recommendations.
System demonstrated strong performance in cold-start scenarios.
Explainability directly contributes to system usability and customer satisfaction.

definitions.definition: Foundation models trained on massive corpora capable of synthesizing information, understanding context, and generating human-like responses.
Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback - uses user feedback as reward function to optimize recommendation model.
Integration of heterogeneous data types including structured and unstructured data for dynamic user profiles.
Techniques like SHAP and LIME that provide transparency into model decision-making.
Privacy-preserving mechanism that adds calibrated noise to protect individual data points.

topics.name: Limitations and Gaps in Existing Systems
topics.justification: Directly addresses limitations of traditional recommendation systems and proposes GenAI solution.

topic_relevance.contribution_to_field: The framework introduces GenAI as paradigm shift for financial product recommendations, combining LLMs, GANs, and RLHF for hyper-personalization. It demonstrates 28-35% improvement in precision/recall, 30% better relevance, and 25% higher engagement. The system handles cold-start scenarios through transfer learning, integrates ethical AI principles with differential privacy and fairness constraints, and provides Explainability-as-a-Service (EaaS) for regulatory compliance. The modular architecture supports deployment across neobanks, credit unions, and financial wellness apps.

limits: Evaluation limited to synthetic datasets due to privacy constraints.

Intersectional fairness (combined attributes) not fully addressed.
Cold-start scenarios handled but need real-world validation.
